source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. From the CISCE Archive Library ICSE 2024 question-paper bundle. Paper code "T24 502" printed on every page. 11 PDF pages: 10 printed pages of questions plus the outline map of India for Question 2 on PDF page 11 (Index No./UID fields and an examiner box only; the map drawing is not in the text layer). To be supplied with the paper: Survey of India Map Sheet No. G43S7 and 20 cm of twine; the map sheet is not part of the PDF. Part I (30 marks, compulsory): Question 1 (topographical map work, five [2] sub-questions, each kept as one entry with its (a)/(b) parts), Question 2 (ten [1] outline-map marking items), Question 3 (ten MCQs printed with a single [10], so 1 mark each). Question 1 and 2 items are imported with hasFigure true and confidence LOW because they cannot be answered without the map sheet / outline map. Question 7 (iv) (page 7) and Question 12 (i) (page 10) refer to pictures that are not reproduced (confidence LOW). Part II (50 marks): "Attempt any five questions" from nine 10-mark questions (4-12); this is a pick-5-of-9 choice, not an OR pair, so choiceGroup is not used and all nine are included. The sum of marks in this pack (120) therefore exceeds maxMarks (80) by design. Part II sub-questions are split at each printed marks bracket ((i)-(iv)); where a bracket covers (a)/(b)/(c) parts, they are kept together in one entry because the marks are printed only for the group. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text: Why is Black soil found suitable for the production of cotton? (Any two points)

Give one difference between each of the following:
(a) Alluvial soil of Uttarakhand and alluvial soil of West Bengal.
(b) Transported soil and residual soil.

With reference to Laterite soil, answer the questions that follow:
(a) How is Laterite soil formed?
(b) How can Laterite soil be made productive?
(c) Name one region where Laterite soil is found.

(a) Mention two causes of soil erosion in India.
(b) Mention a soil conservation method suitable for hilly area.
How is tropical monsoon forest useful for the Indian economy? (Any two points)
Mention the climatic condition that leads to the development of tropical desert vegetation.

Give a reason to explain each of the following:
(a) Mountains have varied vegetation.
(b) Stilt like / aerial roots are a typical feature of littoral forest.
(c) The tropical evergreen forests do not look bare at any time of the year.

(a) How has the rising population of India resulted in the loss of forest cover? (Any one point)
(b) Mention any two forest conservation methods that may be adopted to protect the forests.
Mention one advantage and one disadvantage of using tank irrigation.

(a) What is the advantage of using Drip irrigation?
(b) Why is Drip irrigation not practiced on a large scale in India?

Give a reason to explain each of the following:
(a) Sprinkler irrigation is gaining popularity in recent times.
(b) Tube well irrigation is used in Punjab.
(c) North India has more area under canal irrigation.
